A private illustrated archive

A durable image archive preserves both the story and its illustrations. Each picture belongs to a reader's private copy, and its caption explains the meaning of the picture even when the original website disappears. This original fixture gives the archive a stable text and a real binary corpus without relying on a public website. Reading this article should never contact the source after publication.

The worker checks every destination before downloading an image. A broken picture should not erase a useful article. A clear placeholder explains each missing position while the rest of the story remains available. The saved caption and alternative text belong to that position, so a reader can understand the missing illustration without opening the source.
